ai_notes: [Vintage Fiesta Disc Juice Pitcher (Red)] Red vintage Fiesta is highly sought after due to the uranium glaze history.
description: Circa 1942: The immediate success of the Homer Laughlin's vibrant solid color dinnerware brought on promotions that ran in a multitude of local grocieries and general merchandise stores. Juice sets were their most prolific promo pieces.
